_meta.datasheet: ADI/Linear LTC5552 rev F, Japanese edition 5552f
_meta.datasheet_section: p2 ピン配置 (TOP VIEW, UDB package); p9 ピン機能; p17 UDB Package Variation A, LTC DWG 05-08-1985 Rev 0
_meta.notes: Japanese edition only (English not vendored). Pins 1-3 on the 2 mm side (pin 1 top-left), 4-6 bottom, 7-9 right, 10-12 top.

pins.name: IF+
pins.note: differential IF DC-6 GHz, DC level 0 V; to balun or differential

pins.name: IF-
pins.note: differential IF DC-6 GHz, DC level 0 V

pins.name: RF
pins.note: low DC resistance to GND via internal transformer — series DC block required

pins.name: EN
pins.note: > 1.2 V on, < 0.3 V off; 376 kΩ internal pull-down; abs max VCC+0.3

pins.name: VCC
pins.note: 3.3 V regulated, 132 mA typ / 150 max; abs max 4 V; bypass at pin

pins.name: LO
pins.note: series DC-block cap required (pin ~1.6 V DC)

pins.name: GND
pins.note: exposed pad — must be soldered to PCB GND
